summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, announcing that NI 43-101 technical reports supporting its August 28, 2026 mineral resource announcements for the Motapa maiden estimate and updated Blanket Mine estimate have been filed on SEDAR+. The company states no material changes to prior scientific or technical information; a Blanket life-of-mine plan and updated mineral reserve estimate are expected before year-end. This is a routine resource-disclosure filing, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
